Fixture: every indented line below has to be refused by the rule
no-display-server-in-workflows in .github/invariants.txt.

The lines are workflow steps rather than a whole workflow, because the rule is a
pattern over the text of a file in .github/workflows/ and not a reading of the
YAML. This file sits outside that directory, so it is never scanned as part of
the tree and GitHub never tries to run it.

    - run: sudo apt-get install -y xvfb
    - run: sudo apt-get install -y XVFB
    - run: Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1280x1024x24 &
    - run: sudo apt-get install -y xorg
    - run: export DISPLAY=:99
    - run: echo "WAYLAND_DISPLAY is $WAYLAND_DISPLAY"

The casings are the point of the first three. A package name typed in the case
somebody happens to use is the same step, and a rule matching one spelling of it
is a rule that a different keyboard walks through.

Everything else in this file is prose the rule has to match none of, which the
run asserts by comparing the line numbers that matched against the line numbers
that are indented.
